standard_prerequisites.name: The representability criterion of the form used to construct colimits through a functor commuting with limits
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 6113-6133)

standard_prerequisites.name: The adjoint-exactness statement used to read off commutation with the forgetful functor
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 6136-6140)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the commutation with the forgetful functor to groups.

core_obligations: Set up the functor: consider the contravariant functor of morphisms from the diagram into a topological group, which commutes with limits (proof lines 6112-6121)

Boundedness: for a given element of that functor the images generate a subgroup of bounded cardinality carrying the induced topology, so the representability criterion applies and yields a representing topological group, which is the colimit (proof lines 6122-6133)
Commutation: the forgetful functor has a right adjoint, namely the functor giving a group the indiscrete topology, so adjoint exactness gives the stated commutation (proof lines 6134-6140)
proof_roadmap: 取 F(H) = lim_I Mor_TopGroup(G_i, H)：它与极限交换。
给定 (φ_i : G_i → H) ∈ F(H)，由各像生成的子群（取诱导拓扑）基数不超过 |∐G_i| ⇒ 满足可表示性判据 ⇒ 存在拓扑群 G 表示 F，即 G 是图的余极限。
遗忘函子到群有右伴随（把一个群赋予混沌/密着拓扑）⇒ 由伴随正合性得与遗忘函子交换。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the category of topological groups has colimits and that they commute with the forgetful functors to topological spaces and to groups (author lemma at source lines 6081-6110, label lemma-topological-group-colimits). The proof (source lines 6112-6141) constructs the colimit through a representability criterion by bounding the subgroup generated by the images of the maps in the diagram, and reads off the commutation from the existence of a right adjoint to the forgetful functor (proof lines 6112-6140). The boundedness step and the adjoint argument are the substance. H3.
